findingClass: ipos.issue_size current provenance (field_sources, field_name issueSize) is a source field-manifest.json does NOT rank as capable for this field, on any status/segment including NULL segment or no price cap (item 14, #728 class)

unverifiableWhen: scraper/config/field-manifest.json is missing or has no fields['ipos.issue_size'].capability entry
note: Item 14 (2026-09-24, staging measurement): 8 LISTED + 7 CLOSED IPO rows currently source issueSize from BSE, which the manifest marks capable:false (BSE measured 41-76% below the printed total offer on 6/6 live mainboard IPOs, review round 5 item C).
